access.inviteRoles.operatorAccess.en: Full editing and audit access. Cannot approve join requests or manage member permissions.
access.inviteRoles.operatorAccess.zh-CN: 拥有完整的编辑和审计权限，无法审批加入申请或管理成员权限。

access.inviteRoles.operatorDescription.en: Can edit organization work and invite people.
access.inviteRoles.operatorDescription.zh-CN: 可编辑组织工作并邀请成员。

access.inviteRoles.ownerDescription.en: Full organization access, including membership management.
access.inviteRoles.ownerDescription.zh-CN: 拥有组织的全部权限，包括成员管理。

access.inviteRoles.viewerDescription.en: Can view organization work and follow along.
access.inviteRoles.viewerDescription.zh-CN: 可查看组织工作并了解进展。
